messages:
alex: Heads-up: base image rebuild needs RBAC tweaks + KMS signing. Proposed window Thu 02:00 UTC. Who owns what?
maria: I can take RBAC. Quick scope: new minimal role for signer SA and a puller role for runtime namespaces.
sam: I'll create per-region KMS keys (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Use IRSA/WI so no long-lived creds. Keys will allow kms:Sign for the signer principal only and deny CreateGrant from outside org.
priya: Triage note: rebuild includes glibc/libssl patches. Plan: 5% canary for 48h with smoke + regression evals. Abort on >1% errors or quality regression >5%.
jordan: Audit: enable KMS DataAccess + Admin logs, export to SIEM, retention 90d. Add CloudTrail/Stackdriver selectors for KMS ops.
maria: Draft RBAC snippet posted in PR (Role + RoleBinding) and docs in repo. Will tag @sam for key ARNs.
sam: Policies and drafts: https://git.company/infra/kms/drafts. Will request sec review.
sec-bot: Checklist: 1) Dry-run signing in staging 2) Verify cosign verification in init path 3) Keep last 3 signed tags for rollback 4) Schedule key rotation + quarterly access review.
alex: Rollout plan: keys + policy review Mon, merge RBAC Tue, build+sign Wed, canary Thu 02:00 UTC. Owners: maria (RBAC), sam (KMS), priya (canary/tests), jordan (audit).
priya: I'll add grafana alerts and an incident playbook; Jira INFRA-7123 created for verification rollout.
alex: Good. If KMS auth errors occur, fallback to previous signed image and pause. Notify oncall.
maria: PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/1100 (rbac + README). Please review before Tue EOD.
sam: Keys created in staging; pushing terraform guardrail to prevent wildcard grants.
priya: I'll run the smoke suite after staging sign and report back here.
